themes.finding: A contact expressed willingness to try because families cannot always know how a parent living alone is doing.
themes.implication: Show a short local follow-up workflow.
themes.limit: This is stated interest, not observed trial participation.

themes.finding: A contact prioritised a named responsible person because relatives may each assume somebody else will act.
themes.implication: Lead the Plus explanation with responsibility and recorded follow-up.
themes.limit: A qualitative account, not a measured reduction in missed care.

themes.finding: The team summary asks for large buttons, few steps and simple completed/help choices.
themes.limit: This theme is summarised in S17; it is not an observed older-adult task-performance result.

themes.finding: One contact said RMB39/month could be acceptable with reliable, regular use, but simple reminders alone could feel expensive.
themes.implication: Keep the proposed price and show the workflow beyond reminders.
themes.limit: Conditional price feedback, not a payment commitment.

themes.finding: The summary favours trying the tool first to see whether the older person will use it and communication improves.
themes.implication: Offer the existing free local evaluation.
themes.limit: No completed trial or retention observation supplied.

themes.finding: The summary identifies privacy and access to family information as concerns.
themes.implication: If reopened, validate access control before connected service.
themes.limit: The local demo does not establish production security.

themes.finding: A contact highlighted parents living alone, children in other cities and several relatives sharing care.
themes.implication: Keep this as a segment hypothesis to test.
themes.limit: No representative sample or prevalence estimate.

themes.finding: A contact requested notification of a designated family member after no response and simultaneous updates for relatives.
themes.implication: Record sync and remote notifications as future requirements.
themes.limit: Neither capability is connected in the current local MVP.

commercialOfferAssessment: Ten organisational product-experience invitations were reported sent. Four chat records and one email-list image were selected to demonstrate the outreach without reproducing the entire archive. Eight personal consultations are tracked separately and are not automatically counted as eight commercial offers. Visible greeting examples include Taikang Home, Xinrong Linbang and Xiaode Zhineng; these are outreach examples, not responding partners.
